points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 马克斯·普朗克出生于基尔，父亲是法学教授。他在基尔度过了童年和青少年时期，接受了良好的基础教育。普朗克从小就展现出对音乐和数学的浓厚兴趣，钢琴技艺精湛。这段时期的教育培养了他严谨的思维方式和科学探索精神，为他后来的物理学研究奠定了基础。1874年，普朗克完成了中学教育，准备进入大学深造。
points.descriptionEn: Max Planck was born in Kiel, where his father was a law professor. He spent his childhood and adolescence in Kiel, receiving an excellent education. Planck showed early interest in both music and mathematics, becoming an accomplished pianist. This period of education cultivated his rigorous thinking and scientific curiosity, laying the foundation for his later physics research. In 1874, Planck completed his secondary education and prepared to enter university.

points.title: 大学求学
points.description: 普朗克进入慕尼黑大学学习物理学，师从著名物理学家菲利普·冯·约利。在这里，他深入研究热力学理论，对热力学第二定律产生了浓厚兴趣。1879年，普朗克以论文《论热力学第二定律》获得慕尼黑大学博士学位。他的研究工作已经显示出他对物理学基本问题的深刻思考，特别是关于能量转换和熵的概念。这段时期的学习和研究为他后来提出量子理论奠定了重要基础。
points.descriptionEn: Planck enrolled at the University of Munich to study physics under the renowned physicist Philipp von Jolly. There, he deeply studied thermodynamic theory and developed a keen interest in the second law of thermodynamics. In 1879, Planck received his doctorate from the University of Munich with his dissertation 'On the Second Law of Thermodynamics.' His research already showed his profound thinking on fundamental physics problems, particularly concerning energy conversion and entropy concepts. This period of study laid important groundwork for his later quantum theory.

points.title: 量子理论创立
points.description: 1889年，普朗克被任命为柏林大学理论物理学教授，开始了他在柏林长达近40年的学术生涯。1900年，为了解决黑体辐射问题，普朗克提出了革命性的量子假说，认为能量不是连续的，而是以离散的'量子'形式存在。这一理论彻底改变了物理学的发展方向，成为现代量子力学的基础。普朗克还担任柏林威廉物理研究所首任所长，培养了一代杰出物理学家。他在柏林期间还积极参与德国科学政策的制定，对德国科学界产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1889, Planck was appointed professor of theoretical physics at the University of Berlin, beginning his nearly four-decade academic career in Berlin. In 1900, to solve the black-body radiation problem, Planck proposed his revolutionary quantum hypothesis, stating that energy exists not continuously but in discrete 'quanta.' This theory fundamentally changed the direction of physics development and became the foundation of modern quantum mechanics. Planck also served as the first director of the Kaiser Wilhelm Institute for Physics, nurturing a generation of outstanding physicists. During his time in Berlin, he was also actively involved in shaping German science policy, exerting profound influence on the German scientific community.

points.title: 纳粹时期坚守
points.description: 1933年纳粹上台后，普朗克虽然对纳粹政策持保留态度，但仍选择留在德国。他担任威廉皇帝学会主席，努力保护犹太裔科学家，包括为爱因斯坦等科学家提供支持。普朗克多次与纳粹当局交涉，试图保护科学机构的独立性。尽管面临巨大压力，他仍坚持科学研究，并在哥廷根继续工作。这一时期，普朗克展现了科学家的道德勇气和责任感，尽管他的努力有时受到限制，但他为维护德国科学传统的完整性做出了重要贡献。
points.descriptionEn: After the Nazi rise to power in 1933, Planck, though reserved about Nazi policies, chose to remain in Germany. He served as president of the Kaiser Wilhelm Society, working to protect Jewish scientists, including supporting figures like Einstein. Planck repeatedly negotiated with Nazi authorities, attempting to preserve the independence of scientific institutions. Despite facing immense pressure, he continued his scientific research and worked in Göttingen. During this period, Planck demonstrated the moral courage and responsibility of a scientist, and although his efforts were sometimes limited, he made significant contributions to maintaining the integrity of Germany's scientific tradition.

points.title: 晚年贡献
points.description: 二战结束后，普朗克在哥廷根度过了生命的最后两年。尽管年事已高，他仍积极参与德国科学界的重建工作，为恢复德国的国际科学地位而努力。普朗克撰写了自传《科学自传》，回顾了自己的一生和科学成就。1947年10月4日，普朗克在哥廷根逝世，享年89岁。他的科学遗产和道德风范影响了后世几代科学家，量子理论的发展也因他的奠基性工作而继续深化。普朗克被公认为20世纪最伟大的物理学家之一，他的名字被用于命名普朗克常数、普朗克单位等物理学基本概念。
points.descriptionEn: After World War II, Planck spent his final two years in Göttingen. Despite his advanced age, he actively participated in rebuilding the German scientific community, working to restore Germany's international scientific standing. Planck wrote his scientific autobiography, reflecting on his life and scientific achievements. On October 4, 1947, Planck died in Göttingen at the age of 89. His scientific legacy and moral character influenced generations of scientists, and the development of quantum theory continued to deepen thanks to his foundational work. Planck is widely regarded as one of the greatest physicists of the 20th century, and his name is commemorated in the Planck constant, Planck units, and other fundamental physics concepts.

supporter.zh: 普朗克被尊为现代物理学的奠基人之一，他的量子理论彻底改变了人类对物质世界的认识。作为一位严谨的科学家，他在面对科学困境时展现出非凡的创造力。普朗克不仅推动了科学进步，还在纳粹时期坚守道德底线，保护科学传统，体现了科学家的社会责任感。他的科学成就和道德风范激励着无数后人，成为科学精神的典范。
supporter.en: Planck is revered as one of the founders of modern physics, whose quantum theory revolutionized humanity's understanding of the physical world. As a rigorous scientist, he demonstrated extraordinary creativity when facing scientific challenges. Planck not only advanced scientific progress but also maintained moral principles during the Nazi era, protecting scientific traditions and embodying the social responsibility of scientists. His scientific achievements and moral character continue to inspire countless generations, serving as a model of scientific spirit.

critic.zh: 批评者认为普朗克对量子理论的贡献被过度神话化，他最初提出量子概念时更多是出于数学需要而非物理洞察。此外，他在纳粹时期的立场也受到质疑，有人认为他妥协过多，未能更坚决地抵抗纳粹对科学的破坏。普朗克对相对论的态度也曾摇摆不定，显示出他在面对革命性科学理论时的保守倾向。这些批评反映了科学史上复杂的人性维度和时代局限性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Planck's contributions to quantum theory have been overly mythologized, noting that he initially proposed quantum concepts more out of mathematical necessity than physical insight. Additionally, his stance during the Nazi era has been questioned, with some suggesting he compromised too much and failed to resist more forcefully Nazi destruction of science. Planck's ambivalent attitude toward relativity also reveals his conservative tendencies when facing revolutionary scientific theories. These criticisms reflect the complex human dimensions and historical limitations in the history of science.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，普朗克常被描绘为连接经典物理学与现代物理学的桥梁人物。他的量子理论虽然最初遭到质疑，但最终成为现代物理学的基石。普朗克的形象超越了单纯的科学家，代表着科学探索中的勇气与责任。他的生平故事被用于探讨科学与社会、道德与政治的复杂关系，成为20世纪科学史上的标志性人物。普朗克常数等以他命名的概念已成为物理学的基本符号，象征着人类对微观世界认识的革命性突破。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Planck is often portrayed as a bridge figure connecting classical and modern physics. His quantum theory, though initially met with skepticism, ultimately became the cornerstone of modern physics. Planck's image transcends that of a mere scientist, representing courage and responsibility in scientific exploration. His life story is used to examine the complex relationships between science and society, and between morality and politics, making him an iconic figure in 20th-century scientific history. Concepts named after him, such as the Planck constant, have become fundamental symbols in physics, symbolizing humanity's revolutionary breakthrough in understanding the microscopic world.

self.zh: 科学进步源于对知识的纯粹追求，而非对结果的期待。
self.en: Advancement of science comes from the pursuit of knowledge for its own sake, not from the expectation of results.

others.zh: 普朗克的发现标志着物理学革命的开始，他打开了通往全新世界的大门，这个世界与我们日常经验中的世界截然不同。
others.en: Planck's discovery marked the beginning of a revolution in physics. He opened the door to a new world, a world vastly different from the world of our everyday experience.
